tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT g.Name AS genre, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count,
       MAX(COUNT(t.TrackId)) OVER () AS max_count
FROM Genre g
LEFT JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY g.GenreId
ORDER BY track_count DESC, genre;"}
